informativeness.reason: none of the 18092 measured genes is a DEG under the v2 definition (padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| >= 2.0), so every gene ranks at n_DEG + 1 = 1 and the dataset carries no ordering evidence
informativeness.rule: a dataset is informative when it has at least one DEG under the v2 definition and its measured genes carry more than one distinct continuous effect score; a dataset with no DEG ranks every gene at n_DEG + 1 and a dataset whose measured effects are all tied ranks by gene_index alone, so either carries no ordering evidence (ADR 0068, kept by ADR 0071)

A CM gate would have to be invented from markers, which is forbidden, so the DEG step is not testable. This is a different accession from GSE269882, not an alias of it.

Controlled access remains outside fetched evidence

source_review.scope: Existing pinned source survey, rejected/screened records and owned external items; not a claim of exhaustive public discovery

tiering.rule: Collect all qualifying declared sources in ascending tier order; measure the complete cumulative disease DEG union on the frozen axis (axis-resolved, not genome-wide) after each tier. No DEG-count stopping condition applies. Missing tiers are absent, never back-filled with invented sources.
